indication_area: Osteoporosis (postmenopausal women at high risk of fracture)

launch_evidence.quote: Also in January 2019, the Japanese Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare granted a marketing authorization for EVENITY TM for the treatment of osteoporosis in men and postmenopausal women at high risk of fracture.

series_start_reason: Series starts at 2019Q1, the first quarter with EVENITY sales (Japan, after the January 2019 marketing authorization); the 10-K for 2019 states 'We launched EVENITY ® in the United States and Japan'. 2019Q1 is printed only as the prior-year column of the first-quarter 2020 release.
search_log: Listed every filing for Amgen Inc. (CIK 0000318154) from data.sec.gov/submissions (recent block plus older 'files' pages), no form filter at listing time; selected forms starting '8-K' (8-K and 8-K/A) carrying Item 2.02 and filed 2010-01-01 or later (68 filings), resolved each filing's exhibits from its index.json and kept the non-primary .htm exhibit (Exhibit 99.1; Exhibit 99.2 reconciliation exhibits dropped); also fetched every 10-Q, 10-K, 10-Q/A and 10-K/A primary document filed 2010-04-01 or later.

Each release's HTML table rows were parsed; the product row was located by a regex anchored on the brand at the start of the row (so a combined 'XGEVA / Prolia' row or a regional '- U.S.' row is not taken); the quarter of a release is the calendar quarter before its filing month; the first matching row in a release is the quarter table and the second (Q4 releases) the full-year table.

EVENITY is first on its own line in the second-quarter 2019 release; 2019Q1 (17) is the prior-year TOTAL column of the first-quarter 2020 release, and the first-quarter 2019 release has no EVENITY sales row.

Four quarters vs the full-year TOTAL line of each fourth-quarter release: 2019: 189 vs FY 189; 2020: 350 vs FY 350; 2021: 530 vs FY 530; 2022: 787 vs FY 787; 2023: 1160 vs FY 1160; 2024: 1563 vs FY 1563; 2025: 2100 vs FY 2100. 26 current-quarter rows compared with the prior-year TOTAL column of the following year's release: all equal.
